seo.title: All-inclusive coworking and office rental in Besançon
seo.description: Private offices and open-space desks in central Besançon. All inclusive, no hidden fees. Two addresses: 11 avenue Carnot and 3 rue Granvelle.

hero.text: The iOiO offers turnkey, all-inclusive rental as a service contract: no hidden fees, no add-ons. You sign, you drop your things, and off you go.

places.title: Two spaces in the city centre

items.text: We show you both spaces and the desks still free.

items.text: A service contract, no commercial lease, no admin fees.

items.title: You work
items.text: Drop your things and off you go: furniture, internet and bills are already there.

band.text: You can take your spot and book it: there will not be room for everyone.

items.q: What is included in the price?
items.a: Everything: bills, water, electricity, heating, cleaning, high-speed internet, furniture, meeting room and lounge. The price shown is per month excluding VAT, with no add-ons.

items.q: What kind of contract is it?
items.a: Turnkey rental as a service contract, not a commercial lease. You sign, you drop your things, you work.

items.q: What is the difference between Carnot and Granvelle?
items.a: Carnot, 11 avenue Carnot, gathers 4 closed private offices around an inner courtyard, with a meeting room, kitchen, shower and toilets. Granvelle, 3 rue Granvelle, is the coworking space: private offices or dedicated open-space desks, key locker, bar table and lounge.
Yes. Carnot has a shared meeting room with a video projection system; Granvelle has a bar work table and a sofa corner for informal meetings.
